name: TT Circuit Assen
notes: TT Circuit Assen, the full 4.555 km TT circuit as raced by the DTM in 2019 and 2020 (clockwise). Raceway loop over the TT Circuit ways, without the TT Junior Track. speed_scale 1.0 is uncalibrated; tyre_wear_mult as the base's Valencia. OSM names no pit lane here, so the start line is placed by hand on the pit straight between the GT chicane and the Haarbocht.
